title: Quick Lazy-Sunday Sweet-Rice-Chapssalgaru Pilaf
description: A fluffy and sweet twist on Turkish pilaf featuring chapssalgaru flour mixed with a blend of spices to create an anti-inflammatory dish.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add coriander seeds and cumin powder, sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in ginger powder, turmeric powder, and garam masala. Cook for another minute to toast.
Gradually add sweet-rice and chapssalgaru flour, stirring continuously to prevent sticking.
Pour in enough water to just cover the ingredients, reduce heat to low, and simmer until liquid is absorbed (about 10 minutes).
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.
